subject: Launch Conductor: MAP cadence, owner handoffs, and dry-run windows
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Luke Patterson <luke.p@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Launch Conductor: MAP cadence, owner handoffs, and dry-run windows

Hi Luke —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that aligns milestones, owners, and proposed dry-run windows ahead of your production cutover. The goal is to make the go/no-go decision visible three weeks before cutover and to run a full smoke dry run one week prior.

Key asks from your side:
- Confirm technical owners for integration and data validation (names + emails)
- Confirm target cutover date window (we proposed Sep 20–24)
- Share any procurement or legal gating items that would block SOW signature

Attachments: CloudScale_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (MAP), SOW_draft_v2.pdf (SOW for review)

Next steps: If that timeline looks reasonable, I’ll route this to Marissa for CS handoff and schedule the first alignment call (week of Aug 31).

Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Luke Patterson <luke.p@cloudscale.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Grant <aisha.grant@cloudscale.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch Conductor: MAP cadence, owner handoffs, and dry-run windows

Rafael —

Appreciate the clear draft. A few notes from our side after a quick sync:
- Confirmed cutover target: Sep 22 (we're blocking 22–24 as primary window)
- Technical owners: Luke Patterson (integration lead) and Aisha Grant (data viz/validation) — I'll forward their full contact cards to you after this thread
- Procurement: procurement is reviewing the SOW; we expect a redline within 3 business days, but no blockers expected

We like the idea of a full smoke dry run one week prior. Can Redwood propose exact slot times for the dry run and the go/no-go review?

— Luke
CloudScale Inc
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Luke Patterson <luke.p@cloudscale.com>, Aisha Grant <aisha.grant@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch Conductor: MAP cadence, owner handoffs, and dry-run windows

Perfect — thanks Luke. Proposed slots (all in PDT):
- Dry run (full smoke): Sep 15 09:00–11:30
- Go/no-go review: Sep 15 15:00–16:00 (same day, earlier tie-out gives buffer)

If Sep 15 works for you, we’ll schedule a 90-min dry run that covers:
- End-to-end request flow and performance checks (20m)
- KV/prefix cache verification with sample payloads (30m)
- Failure injection: latency/cold-start simulation (20m)
- Acceptance checklist and rollback plan (20m)

I’m looping Marissa to begin the CS handoff and to propose an internal runbook owner for post-cutover 30/60/90 day ops.

Rafael
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Luke Patterson <luke.p@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch Conductor: MAP cadence, owner handoffs, and dry-run windows

Thanks Rafael & Luke — I’ll take point on the CS handoff. A few items I’m capturing as immediate actions:

1) Owner roster (please confirm by EOD Aug 25)
   - Redwood: Marissa Cole (CS lead), Neha Kapoor (Post-go-live SRE liaison)
   - CloudScale: Luke Patterson (Integration), Aisha Grant (Data)

2) Acceptance criteria — quick summary for the MAP:
   - 99th pct latency within agreed SLO on test harness
   - Sample payloads (provided by CloudScale) processed with zero data loss
   - Telemetry shows KV cache warm-up behavior consistent with baseline

3) Dry-run logistics: I’ll send a calendar invite for Sep 15 09:00–11:30 and include a runbook checklist. Please confirm the preferred Slack channel for the live run (we suggest #cloudscale-launch).

Attachments referenced: CloudScale_MAP_v0.3.xlsx — I’ll update owner columns and return v0.4 by Aug 26.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Luke Patterson <luke.p@cloudscale.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch Conductor: MAP cadence, owner handoffs, and dry-run windows

Quick confirm from SRE side — Sept 15 dry run slot works for our on-call rotation. A few SRE prechecks we’ll run the week prior:
- Baseline perf sweep (token rates & tail latencies)
- KV cache priming script run (we’ll share tool + sample invocation)
- Telemetry retention config check (ensure 30d retention for run artifacts)

I’ll add the prechecks to the MAP and put the checklist link in the calendar invite. Looking forward to the run.

— Neha
Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
